title: Sega Flash Vol. 7
overview:
Sega Flash Vol. 7 is a free European demo disc from Sega, given away in the UK with Sega Saturn Magazine. It collects playable demos and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Steep Slope Sliders
- Sega Touring Car Championship
- A Sega soccer game

Non-playable previews:
- Burning Rangers
- Panzer Dragoon Saga
- Enemy Zero
- Shining Force III
- The House of the Dead
- Winter Heat
- Sonic R
- NBA Action 98
